say:0:1011401001:0.text: For Korin, and for all the refugees who came to the forest.
say:0:1011401001:0.source_cn: 为了科林，也为了所有来到丛林中的逃难者。

say:1:1011401002:0.text: We must find Master Eomir and make him lift the order.
say:1:1011401002:0.source_cn: 一定要找到伊米尔贤者，让他改弦更张。

say:0:1011402001:0.text: This way! I remember the Moongloss Spring is nearby!
say:0:1011402001:0.source_cn: 哦，是这条路！我记得这条路旁有一处荧月泉眼。

say:1:1011402002:0.text: The water is exceptionally clear, and you often see wild animals quenching their thirst there.
say:1:1011402002:0.source_cn: 水质非常清冽，经常能看到野生动物在附近喝水。

say:0:1011404001:0.text: Hey, look! There's a girl lying in the flowerbed by the roadside.
say:0:1011404001:0.source_cn: ——咦？！你们看，路边花丛里，是不是倒着个女孩子？

say:1:1011404002:0.source_cn: 帕瑞莎……？帕瑞莎怎么会在这里！

say:0:1011406001:0.text: Thank goodness... Looks like she just drank too much calmflower tea.
say:0:1011406001:0.source_cn: ……幸好。看样子只是喝多了安神花茶……

say:1:1011406002:0.text:
We can wake her up with smelling salts.
Parisa, wake up! It's us!
say:1:1011406002:0.source_cn: 用嗅盐就可以让她清醒过来。\n帕瑞莎，醒醒，是我们！

say:3:1011407002:1.text: Why are you all in my dream? I don't think you did anything wrong...
say:3:1011407002:1.source_cn: 为什么要到我的梦里来？你们明明没有过错……

say:4:1011407003:1.text: You just passed out after drinking too much calmflower tea!
say:4:1011407003:1.source_cn: 帕瑞莎，清醒一下！你喝了太多安神花茶，刚刚昏睡过去了。

say:6:1011407005:1.text: Why are even dreams so fleeting? I haven't repented to Misarte yet...
say:6:1011407005:1.source_cn: 为什么连梦都这么短暂？我还没向弥萨忒谢罪……

choice_prompt:7:1011407005.text: Why are even dreams so fleeting? I haven't repented to Misarte yet...
choice_prompt:7:1011407005.source_cn: 为什么连梦都这么短暂？我还没向弥萨忒谢罪……

say:8:1011407006:1.text: You don't look like a Wilder from the way you dress...
say:8:1011407006:1.source_cn: 你……？你的穿着，不是绿裔联盟的人。
say:8:1011407006:1.male: You don't look like a Wilder from the way you dress...
say:8:1011407006:1.female: You don't look like a Wilder from the way you dress...

say:9:1011407007:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is the mage Lorsan invited back to cleanse the corruption.
say:9:1011407007:1.source_cn: 这位是洛桑从外界请来，专门处理丛林腐化的魔法师，<st...
say:9:1011407007:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is the mage Lorsan invited back to cleanse the corruption.
say:9:1011407007:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is the mage Lorsan invited back to cleanse the corruption.

say:10:1011407008:1.text: Parisa, I don't mean to sound rude, but do you really think the exclusion edict is a good idea? While it keeps out the corruption, it also shuts the door on others' good intentions.
say:10:1011407008:1.source_cn: 帕瑞莎，我很不想这么说，但封锁丛林真的是一件好事吗？虽...

say:11:1011407009:0.text: As the <style="highlight">Captain of the Thorned Guards</style>, could you please urge Master Eomir to give the matter a second thought?

choice_prompt:12:1011407009.text: As the <style="highlight">Captain of the Thorned Guards</style>, could you please urge Master Eomir to give the matter a second thought?
choice_prompt:12:1011407009.source_cn: 你是荆棘卫队的队长，能不能以荆棘的名义，请伊米尔贤者再做考虑呢？

say:15:1011407010:0.text: The Thorned Guards looks so tough. I didn't expect their captain to be such a beautiful lady!
say:15:1011407010:0.source_cn: 荆棘卫队那么强硬，没想到卫队长竟然是帕瑞莎小姐这么美丽的人！

say:16:1011407011:1.text: Even the most beautiful roses have thorns. Looks don't matter. What matters is the will to protect the forest.
say:16:1011407011:1.source_cn: 繁美之花也会有尖刺。相貌无关紧要，重要的是守护之心。

say:19:1011407013:0.text: I am no longer captain of the Thorned Guards.
say:19:1011407013:0.source_cn: 呵，我已经不是荆棘卫队的队长了。

choice_prompt:20:1011407013.text: I am no longer captain of the Thorned Guards.
choice_prompt:20:1011407013.source_cn: 呵，我已经不是荆棘卫队的队长了。

say:21:1011407014:1.text: The new captain has been chosen from the elite, but the ultimate authority lies with Master Eomir.
say:21:1011407014:1.source_cn: 新任队长是从精锐中重新任命的，但……真正拥有指挥权的，...
say:21:1011407014:1.male: The new captain has been chosen from the elite, but the ultimate authority lies with Master Eomir.
say:21:1011407014:1.female: The new captain has been chosen from the elite, but the ultimate authority lies with Master Eomir.

say:22:1011407015:1.text: I expressed my concerns about the exclusion edict and repeatedly advised Master Eomir to reconsider his decision...
say:22:1011407015:1.source_cn: 封锁令下达以后，我深觉不妥，数次向伊米尔贤者谏言，希望...

say:23:1011407016:0.text: Unfortunately, he remains convinced that the corruption in the forest is caused by humans, and by sealing it off, we can cut off its source.
say:23:1011407016:0.source_cn: 但他坚信丛林的腐化是由人类造成的，只要封锁丛林，就能隔...

say:24:1011407017:1.text: Later, I was relieved of my duties due to my supposed incompetence and perceived disloyalty. My companions, including <style="highlight">Vice Captain Kafra</style>, were also reassigned.
say:24:1011407017:1.source_cn: 后来……因为办事不力，心向外敌，我被革职了。我的部下们...

say:26:1011407018:0.text: But wasn't it Eomir who first saw your sense of responsibility and made you captain?
say:26:1011407018:0.source_cn: 但最早看中你的责任心，并任命你为队长的人，不就是伊米尔吗？

say:27:1011407019:1.text: It's probably due to my defiance... In any case, there's no longer a place for me in the camp.
say:27:1011407019:1.source_cn: 是因为我的违逆吧……总之，荆棘主营里，已经没有我的位置了。

choice_prompt:28:1011407019.text: It's probably due to my defiance... In any case, there's no longer a place for me in the camp.
choice_prompt:28:1011407019.source_cn: 是因为我的违逆吧……总之，荆棘主营里，已经没有我的位置了。

say:29:1011407020:1.text: What you don't understand as an outlander is that, with or without the title, I'm a member of the Thorned Guards.
say:29:1011407020:1.source_cn: 外乡人，无论有没有卫队长的头衔，我都是荆棘的人。
say:29:1011407020:1.male: What you don't understand as an outlander is that, with or without the title, I'm a member of the Thorned Guards.
say:29:1011407020:1.female: What you don't understand as an outlander is that, with or without the title, I'm a member of the Thorned Guards.

say:30:1011407021:1.text: The Thorned Guards have been up to no good lately. As the former captain, I'm powerless to intervene or advise them.
say:30:1011407021:1.source_cn: 荆棘卫队最近做了多少恶事。作为前队长，我既无法阻止他们...

say:31:1011407022:1.text: How can I face the people of Lunadorf and beg for shelter?!
say:31:1011407022:1.source_cn: 这样的我，还有什么脸面，再去恳求月湖村的薄暮民众收留呢？！

say:32:1011407023:1.text: Is that why you sought refuge in the dream realm just now?
say:32:1011407023:1.source_cn: 所以你才想靠进入梦境来逃避一切吗……

say:33:1011407024:1.text: That was the only way I could repent to Misarte!
say:33:1011407024:1.source_cn: ——那是我唯一可以向弥萨忒谢罪的方法！

choice_prompt:34:1011407024.text: That was the only way I could repent to Misarte!
choice_prompt:34:1011407024.source_cn: ——那是我唯一可以向弥萨忒谢罪的方法！

say:38:1011407027:1.text: Parisa, when faced with an outlander who can cleanse corruption, will Eomir stick to his earlier decision?
say:38:1011407027:1.source_cn: 帕瑞莎，在能净化腐化的外来者面前，伊米尔还会坚持之前的...
say:38:1011407027:1.male: Parisa, when faced with an outlander who can cleanse corruption, will Eomir stick to his earlier decision?
say:38:1011407027:1.female: Parisa, when faced with an outlander who can cleanse corruption, will Eomir stick to his earlier decision?

say:39:1011407028:1.text: His resistance to external support would drag the forest deeper into the mire, rather than helping our shared home.
say:39:1011407028:1.source_cn: 面对来自外界的助力，他的坚持，会将丛林拖入更深的泥淖，...
say:39:1011407028:1.male: His resistance to external support would drag the forest deeper into the mire, rather than helping our shared home.
say:39:1011407028:1.female: His resistance to external support would drag the forest deeper into the mire, rather than helping our shared home.

say:41:1011407030:1.text: Can you really cleanse the corruption?
say:41:1011407030:1.male: Can you really cleanse the corruption?
say:41:1011407030:1.female: Can you really cleanse the corruption?

say:42:1011407031:1.text: I guess there's no reason to doubt you since both Eironn and Lyca spoke highly of you.
say:42:1011407031:1.source_cn: 不，埃隆和莱卡都这么说了，应该不会有假。
say:42:1011407031:1.male: I guess there's no reason to doubt you since both Eironn and Lyca spoke highly of you.
say:42:1011407031:1.female: I guess there's no reason to doubt you since both Eironn and Lyca spoke highly of you.

say:43:1011407032:1.text: Lyca of the Dusk Faction, Lorsan of the Wind Faction, and the Scion of the Lucent Tree who is fated to save the Dark Forest...
say:43:1011407032:1.source_cn: 薄暮的莱卡，风语的洛桑，传说中能拯救丛林的流荧树之子……
say:43:1011407032:1.male: Lyca of the Dusk Faction, Lorsan of the Wind Faction, and the Scion of the Lucent Tree who is fated to save the Dark Forest...
say:43:1011407032:1.female: Lyca of the Dusk Faction, Lorsan of the Wind Faction, and the Scion of the Lucent Tree who is fated to save the Dark Forest...

say:44:1011407033:1.text: Of the three factions, only the Thorned Faction remains resistant to change...

say:45:1011407034:1.text: Come with me, I'll take you to Eomir.
say:45:1011407034:1.source_cn: 来吧，我带你们去荆棘主营找伊米尔。

choice:34:0:1.text: Who says so? We're off to find Eomir!
choice:34:0:1.source_cn: 谁说的，我们正要去找伊米尔
choice:34:0:1.male: Who says so? We're off to find Eomir!
choice:34:0:1.female: Who says so? We're off to find Eomir!

say:47:1011407025:0.source_cn: 外乡人，难道你还有别的办法？

choice:28:0:1.text: Why didn't you go to Lunadorf?
choice:28:0:1.male: Why didn't you go to Lunadorf?
choice:28:0:1.female: Why didn't you go to Lunadorf?

choice:20:1:2.source_cn: 现在指挥荆棘的人，是谁？

choice:12:0:1.text: You're Captain of the Thorned Guards?
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 你就是荆棘卫队的队长？
choice:12:0:1.male: You're Captain of the Thorned Guards?
choice:12:0:1.female: You're Captain of the Thorned Guards?

say:0:1011408001:0.text: The Thorned Guards are stationed further ahead.
say:0:1011408001:0.source_cn: 再往前就是荆棘卫队的驻扎范围了。

say:1:1011408002:0.text: They are more against the outlanders than you know, so be careful.
say:1:1011408002:0.source_cn: 卫队比你们所知的更排外，小心。

say:2:1011410001:1.text: Drisga, we are here to see Master Eomir.
say:2:1011410001:1.source_cn: 德里斯加，我们求见伊米尔贤者。

say:4:1011410003:1.text: Wait no, you're no longer the captain. You have no right to enter the Thorned camp!
say:4:1011410003:1.source_cn: 不对，你已经不再是队长，无权进入荆棘营地！

say:5:1011410004:1.text: Please step aside and let us in.

say:6:1011410005:1.text: They all claimed you were conspiring with outsiders. I didn't believe it. But now, it appears to be true.
say:6:1011410005:1.source_cn: ……他们都说你勾结外人，我还不相信。如今亲眼所见，果然...

say:7:1011410006:0.text: Why are you bringing a Dusk Patroller and a Windwhisperer into our camp? You were once Master Eomir's most trusted advisor, and now you're defying his orders?!
say:7:1011410006:0.source_cn: 你带着薄暮和风语的人，闯进营地是想做什么？当初是伊米尔...

say:8:1011410007:1.text: Drisga, the Thorned Guards' mission is to protect the forest, not blindly champion the will of one sage.
say:8:1011410007:1.source_cn: 德里斯加，荆棘卫队的使命是保护丛林，而非一昧拥护贤者。

say:9:1011410008:0.text: Now, are the Thorned Guards still worthy of being called the guardians of the forest?
say:9:1011410008:0.source_cn: 现在的荆棘，还称得上是丛林的护卫吗？

say:10:1011410009:0.text: You're the one who betrayed us!

say:11:1011410010:0.text: Guards! Get them out of here!
say:11:1011410010:0.source_cn: 卫士们，列队！把他们赶出去！

say:3:1011412002:1.text: We still have a ways to go before reaching Eomir's tent.
say:3:1011412002:1.source_cn: 离到主帐见伊米尔，还有一段距离。

say:4:1011412003:1.text: What?! Will there be more battles like that ahead?
say:4:1011412003:1.source_cn: 什么，后面还要经历很多这样的战斗吗？！

say:5:1011412004:1.text: That last battle made me want to turn tail and run!
say:5:1011412004:1.source_cn: 刚才那一战，我的尾巴都被吓得缩起来了！

say:6:1011412005:1.text: The Thorned Guards never slack off in training... We work hard to protect the forest...
say:6:1011412005:1.source_cn: 荆棘卫士……为了守护丛林，我们训练时从来不会懈怠。

say:7:1011412006:1.text: But what are they trying to protect now?
say:7:1011412006:1.source_cn: 只是，现在的荆棘，又在守护什么呢？

say:0:1011413001:0.text: Magister! Isn't that the Adamant Syndicate's emblem?!
say:0:1011413001:0.source_cn: 主、主人！那不是黑金商会的标志吗？！
say:0:1011413001:0.male: Magister! Isn't that the Adamant Syndicate's emblem?!
say:0:1011413001:0.female: Magister! Isn't that the Adamant Syndicate's emblem?!

say:1:1011413002:0.text: Adamant Syndicate...? These camps were here before I was captain.
say:1:1011413002:0.source_cn: 黑金商会……？这些营帐在我成为队长前就有了。

say:2:1011413003:0.text: Seems fishy. Let's keep searching; maybe we can find some clues.
say:2:1011413003:0.source_cn: 很蹊跷。还是搜寻看看吧，也许能发现线索。
say:2:1011413003:0.male: Seems fishy. Let's keep searching; maybe we can find some clues.
say:2:1011413003:0.female: Seems fishy. Let's keep searching; maybe we can find some clues.

say:3:1011414001:1.text: Lady Illucia! Is she the same person as <style="highlight">the lady in black conducting grape experiments</style> in Ryeham?
say:3:1011414001:1.source_cn: 伊露西卡女士！她和在金穗村<style=highlig...

say:4:1011414002:1.text: What?! She's in the Dark Forest?!
say:4:1011414002:1.source_cn: 什么？！那家伙也来薄暮丛林了？！

say:5:1011414003:1.text: Who's this Lady Illucia you're talking about?

choice_prompt:6:1011414003.text: Who's this Lady Illucia you're talking about?

say:7:1011414004:1.text: Not sure if they're the same person... But there must be some correlation between the corruption and the Syndicate camp!
say:7:1011414004:1.source_cn: 不知道她们是不是同一个人……不过丛林出现腐化，还有废弃...

say:10:1011414005:1.text: Could she be behind the forest corruption as well?
say:10:1011414005:1.source_cn: ……莫非，丛林的腐化也出自于她之手吗？

say:11:1011414006:1.text: Too bad the parchment was incinerated... only bits and pieces were left behind...
say:11:1011414006:1.source_cn: 可惜羊皮纸被焚烧了，只留下只言片语……

say:12:1011414007:1.text: Hopefully, we can stumble upon more clues later on.
say:12:1011414007:1.source_cn: 不知以后能否再发现其他线索。

choice:6:1:2.text: She was behind the Ryeham incident.
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 黑衣女士是金穗村异变的幕后人
choice:6:1:2.male: She was behind the Ryeham incident.
choice:6:1:2.female: She was behind the Ryeham incident.

say:0:1011415001:0.text: I didn't expect to see traces of the Adamant Syndicate in the Dark Forest...
say:0:1011415001:0.source_cn: 没想到薄暮丛林里真有黑金商会的影子……

say:1:1011415002:0.text: The note said... Lady Illucia, phase one succeeded, please retreat...
say:1:1011415002:0.source_cn: 伊露西卡女士，初步成功的计划，撤离命令……
say:1:1011415002:0.male: The note said... Lady Illucia, phase one succeeded, please retreat...
say:1:1011415002:0.female: The note said... Lady Illucia, phase one succeeded, please retreat...

say:2:1011415003:0.text: The corruption must be their doing! Who else could it be?
say:2:1011415003:0.source_cn: 要我说，腐化肯定是他们搞的！不然还能是谁？！

cinematic_dialogue:2:1011416001:.text: Time turns cold, nature withers away.

say:6:1011417001:1.text: T-That woman with the pale face and the long black dress!
say:6:1011417001:1.source_cn: 那……那个女人！黑色长裙，苍白的脸……！

say:7:1011417002:1.text: She has to be the <style="highlight">lady in black</style> who worked with Franz!
say:7:1011417002:1.source_cn: 她就是和弗朗茨合作的<style=highlight>...

say:8:1011417003:1.text: We finally found the culprit! She's been using magic to corrupt the entire Dark Forest.
say:8:1011417003:1.source_cn: 终于被我们找到罪魁祸首了！就是她在用刚才的法术，四处在...

say:9:1011417004:1.text: Is it really the Lightbearers who are corrupting the forest?
say:9:1011417004:1.source_cn: 腐化丛林的，真的是耀光帝国的人吗……

say:10:1011417005:1.text: Could it be that Master Eomir is right...?
say:10:1011417005:1.source_cn: 伊米尔贤者的主张，竟然是对的……？

say:16:1011417008:1.text: Pale skin, a whiff of decay, no heartbeat... *Gasp* She's a...
say:16:1011417008:1.source_cn: 灰白的皮肤，腐朽的气息，无法跳动的心脏，她是——

choice_prompt:17:1011417008.text: Pale skin, a whiff of decay, no heartbeat... *Gasp* She's a...
choice_prompt:17:1011417008.source_cn: 灰白的皮肤，腐朽的气息，无法跳动的心脏，她是——

say:19:1011417010:0.text: I've read about the realm of the Graveborns, the <style="highlight">Bantus Empire</style>, and tales of restless souls...
say:19:1011417010:0.source_cn: 我曾经在书上读到过，亡者群集的国度，<style=hi...

say:20:1011417011:0.text: But why did they suddenly appear in the Dark Forest? Wilders never interact with them nor do we have any grudges.
say:20:1011417011:0.source_cn: 但，亡灵怎么会突然来到薄暮丛林呢？这里的绿裔成员和他们...

say:21:1011417012:1.text: I see... So the corruption is created by foreign magic. No wonder neither sword nor flame can sever its regeneration.
say:21:1011417012:1.source_cn: 腐化原来是由外来魔法造就的，怪不得凭剑刃和火焰，都无法...

say:22:1011417013:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, would you mind having your familiar inspect the state of the corrupted roots regenerated by that Graveborn lady?
say:22:1011417013:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, would you mind having your familiar inspect the state of the corrupted roots regenerated by that Graveborn lady?
say:22:1011417013:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, would you mind having your familiar inspect the state of the corrupted roots regenerated by that Graveborn lady?

say:25:1011417014:1.text: Roger that! Leave it to Chippy!
say:25:1011417014:1.male: Roger that! Leave it to Chippy!
say:25:1011417014:1.female: Roger that! Leave it to Chippy!

choice:12:2:3.text: A whiff of decay surrounds her.
choice:12:2:3.source_cn: 她周围有一股腐朽的气息
choice:12:2:3.male: A whiff of decay surrounds her.
choice:12:2:3.female: A whiff of decay surrounds her.

narration:27:1011426:0.text: A woman in a black dress was found corrupting the forest, and you happen to stumble upon her.
narration:27:1011426:0.source_cn: 一个穿着黑色长裙的女人正在施法腐化丛林，刚好被你们撞见。

say:1:1011417102:0.text: Chippy is 100% sure! The roots here all extend <style="highlight">south</style>!
